verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's automation is built around event-triggered Runbooks (triggered on incident declaration or alert conditions) and On-Call Schedules (staffing rotations), not scheduled/cron-style recurring execution of jobs or workflows; no evidence shows a way to run a Runbook or workflow on a time-based recurring schedule. Missing for 10: any documented cron/timer-based trigger for Runbooks or workflows, scheduled automation API/UI, or recurring job execution beyond on-call rotation staffing.
